narr: Diurnal heating and a moisture convergence along a boundary just south of the Tennessee River produced scattered strong to severe shower and thunderstorm development in portions of northwestern Alabama and Cullman county. Some heavy rainfall occurred causing some ponding of water on roadways as well.
ev: Ponding of water across Cherokee Avenue at AL Hwy 69 near the Industrial District. Depth of water unknown.
lsr: PONDING ACROSS CHERROKKE AVE/ 69 N NEAR THE INDUSTRIAL DISTRICT.
